content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM
content_sections.text: NIFTEM, Kundli is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Govt of India. Its address in the notice is Plot No. 97, Sector 56, HSIIDC Industrial Estate, Kundli, District Sonipat, Haryana 131028. The posts are for its Satellite/Regional Centre at Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Young Professional (YP), with 02 positions. The conditions are given below. Bachelor's degree/ Master's degree with 60% in the area of Process and Food Engineering / Food Science & Technology / Food Technology Management / Food Process Engineering Management and relevant field. Minimum one year of relevant experience in the food-processing industry, particularly in Production and QA/QC, and/or in skill development activities as an instructor/trainer, including development and delivery of training programmes aligned with NSQF job roles. Preference will be given to candidates having hands-on experience in operating food-processing machinery, relevant industrial experience, and knowledge of Government of India and Government of Uttar Pradesh schemes relating to the food-processing sector. Good communication skill. Prior Food Industry or Food Sector skilling experience. The age limit is maximum 30 years, with a relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC as per Government of India rules. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: NIFTEM Young Professional (YP) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Young Professional shall assist NIFTEM in planning and conducting industry-oriented skill development and capacity-building programmes for youth, food-processing workers and aspiring entrepreneurs. Key responsibilities shall include: Skill Development and Training: Organise and conduct practical training programmes in food processing, preservation, packaging and allied operations. Hands-on Technical Training: Demonstrate the operation, handling, cleaning and basic maintenance of food-processing machinery and equipment. Training Module Development: Develop training materials, practical exercises and Standard Operating Procedures aligned with industry requirements and relevant NSQF job roles. Production and Quality Control: Conduct practical sessions on food production, process control, quality assurance, food safety, hygiene, GMP and GHP. Entrepreneurship Development: Facilitate training for micro and small food-processing entrepreneurs, particularly under the PMFME Scheme of MoFPI, covering processing, product development, packaging and quality compliance. Industry Linkages: Coordinate with food-processing industries, MSMEs, FPOs and other stakeholders to identify skill gaps and facilitate industry exposure and practical learning. Assessment and Employment Facilitation: Assist in trainee assessment, certification, employment linkages and promotion of self-employment and micro-enterprises. Programme Monitoring and Reporting: Maintain training records, trainee databases, attendance, feedback and outcome reports, including employment and enterprise-development outcomes. Other Duties: Undertake related technical, training and programme-coordination responsibilities assigned by the Competent Authority.
